evals.name: Unread mail request activates gws Gmail triage
evals.prompt: Can you check my unread email and summarize what's waiting?
evals.expected_output: Loads google-workspace-gws or a gws-gmail helper skill, uses the terminal to run the local gws CLI (e.g. gws gmail +triage or gws gmail users messages list), and does not claim Hermes lacks a Gmail tool before trying gws.
assertions: Mentions skill_view or loading google-workspace-gws or gws-gmail
Mentions gws gmail or gws CLI
Mentions terminal or running a shell command
Does not say Gmail or email access is unavailable without checking gws first
Does not invent a separate Hermes Gmail API tool

evals.name: Gmail access question verifies gws before refusing
evals.prompt: Do you have access to my Gmail?
evals.expected_output: Explains Gmail is accessed via the local gws CLI through terminal, runs or proposes command -v gws and gws auth status, loads the google-workspace-gws skill, and only reports no access if gws is missing or auth is invalid.
assertions: Mentions gws
Mentions command -v gws or gws auth status
Mentions skill_view or google-workspace-gws
Does not flatly deny Gmail access without a gws check
Clarifies access is via CLI not a built-in Hermes Gmail tool

evals.name: Send email request routes to gws send helpers
evals.prompt: Send an email to team@example.com with subject 'Ship status' and a one-line body that we're green.
evals.expected_output: Loads gws-gmail-send or google-workspace-gws, uses gws gmail +send or gws gmail users messages send via terminal, and confirms auth/binary before giving up.
assertions: Mentions gws gmail +send or gws gmail users messages send
Mentions skill_view or gws-gmail-send or google-workspace-gws
Uses terminal or shell to run gws
Does not claim there is no email-sending tool without checking gws
Does not use Resend or BlueBubbles for a Gmail send request

evals.name: Casual 'mail' wording still activates gws
evals.prompt: Anything important in my mail from the last day?
evals.expected_output: Treats mail as Gmail/Google Workspace, loads google-workspace-gws or gws-gmail-triage, and queries via gws rather than refusing for lack of tools.
assertions: Mentions gws
Mentions google-workspace-gws or gws-gmail
Mentions inbox or unread or messages list or triage
Does not say it cannot read mail without attempting gws
Does not route to iMessage or Resend

evals.name: Non-email tasks should not force gws
evals.prompt: Restart the Hermes gateway and confirm BlueBubbles webhook health.
evals.expected_output: Focuses on Hermes gateway and BlueBubbles diagnostics without loading google-workspace-gws or running gws gmail commands.
assertions: Mentions gateway or BlueBubbles or webhook
Does not run gws gmail
Does not load google-workspace-gws for this unrelated ops task
